text: Venus rotates once every 243 Earth days, the slowest rotation of any planet in the solar system.
Venus orbits the Sun every 225 Earth days, so a Venusian day is longer than its year.
Olympus Mons on Mars is the tallest volcano in the solar system, standing about 22 kilometers high.
Saturn has 146 confirmed moons, the most of any planet.
Jupiter has 95 confirmed moons and is the largest planet by mass and volume.
Mercury is the smallest planet and the closest to the Sun.
A light-year is the distance light travels in one year, roughly 9.46 trillion kilometers.
The Sun contains about 99.86 percent of all the mass in the solar system.
Neptune is the windiest planet, with winds reaching about 2,100 kilometers per hour.
